why: Florist shops sell fresh flowers and plants, need FEFO food tracking for flower freshness, delivery window scheduling and order management. The key is FEFO tracking and delivery slot management.
operator: The florist owner manages fresh flower inventory, delivery schedules and customer orders. Their day is flower stock checks, delivery slot scheduling and vase-life tracking.
entities: Shop (id, nameAr, nameEn, branchId, address, phone, currency, taxRegistration, openingHours)
FlowerBundle (id, shopId, nameAr, nameEn, flowerTypes (array), pricePiasters, bundlePricePiasters, discountPercent, validityDays, status, notes)
FlowerStock (id, shopId, flowerType, source (local/international), pricePiasters per stem, stemQty, reorderPoint, status, locationShelf)
CustomerOrder (id, shopId, customerName, customerPhone, bundleId, quantity, deliveryDate, deliveryTimeSlot, status (pending/confirmed/out-for-delivery/done), notes, paymentStatus)
Supplier (id, shopId, name, phone, paymentTerms, visitDays, leadTimeDays)
PurchaseOrder (id, supplierId, status, lines, expectedAt, totalPiasters)
Staff (id, shopId, name, phone, role, hourlyRatePiasters, status)
batches: Yes for cut flowers: FEFO batches with supplier, received date, expiry date (vase life days) and cost
expiry: Cut flowers have vase-life expiry tracked per batch; the shop sees alerts for flowers fading in 3/5/7 days
special: The core structures are the flower bundle with discount and validity, the per-stem stock with FEFO vase-life, the customer order with delivery slot and the vase-life care instructions. FEFO flower freshness is the key differentiator from regular retail.
screens: Flower bundle catalogue: list of bundles with name, flower types, price, bundle price, discount %, validity days, status
Flower stock level: stems per type, source, reorder point, FEFO vase-life badge and expiry alert
Customer order creation: select bundle, enter customer name/phone, select delivery date/time slot, set status (pending/confirmed), compute total (bundle price - discount), set payment status
Order list: all orders with bundle, customer, delivery date/time, status, payment status
Vase life tracker: per flower type, average days, care instructions, fade alert per bundle
Supplier management: list of suppliers per shop, payment terms, lead time, contact
Purchase order: create per shop, receive from supplier, update flower stock
Cash register per shop: scan bundle SKU or product, apply FEFO discount if urgent, tender payment, print receipt with bundle details and vase-life notes
roles: Owner: everything : bundles, stock, orders, reports, billing
Flower specialist: create bundles, manage stock, process orders, handle vase-life alerts
Sales rep: manage products, create bundles, handle customer orders
Cashier: scan bundle SKU, tender payment, print receipt
reports: Bundle sales per period: bundles created, sold, expired per month, revenue per bundle per period
FEFO vase-life aggregate: total stems fading per period by days (3/5/7), value at risk, discounts applied
Order pipeline: orders by status per period, average delivery time per period
Customer retention: order count per customer, total spent per customer, re-order rate
Stock turnover: stems per type per period, reorder frequency, FEFO expiry vs stock ratio
integrations: Esc/POS thermal printer per shop for receipts and vase-life care cards
WhatsApp deep link per customer for delivery notifications and vase-care tips
Email for order confirmations and vase-care tips (opt-in)
SMS for FEFO expiry alerts to customers (optional)
onboarding: Shop basics: name, branch, address, phone, currency, working hours
Initial bundles: the starting bundle list with flower types, price, discount and validity days
Flower stock: the starting stem list with source, price per stem, reorder point and FEFO vase-life days
Staff: add the initial team with their role templates
First week plan: create first bundle, first customer order, first supplier order
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the flower bundle/vase-life flag and role templates.

tasks.title: Add flower bundle catalogue
tasks.brief: Build the bundle catalogue: list of bundles with name, flower types, price, bundle price, discount %, validity days, status. Done when the catalogue loads and displays bundles with correct badge and validity info.
tasks.done: When bundle catalogue displays live data with validity and discount info

tasks.title: Add flower stock level with FEFO vase-life
tasks.brief: Build the stock screen: stems per type, source, reorder point, FEFO vase-life badge and expiry alert. Done when the stock level saves and vase-life alert triggers correctly when approaching expiry.
tasks.done: When flower stock level works and vase-life alerts trigger correctly

tasks.title: Add customer order creation with delivery slot
tasks.brief: Build the order screen: select bundle, enter customer name/phone, select delivery date/time slot, set status (pending/confirmed), compute total (bundle price - discount), set payment status. Done when the order saves all fields and the receipt prints correctly.
tasks.done: When customer order creation works end-to-end with delivery slot and receipt prints

tasks.title: Add vase life tracker per flower type
tasks.brief: Build the vase life screen: average days per flower type, care instructions Ar/En, fade alert per bundle. Done when the tracker saves and fade alerts update correctly.
tasks.done: When vase life tracker works end-to-end with fade alerts

tasks.title: Add supplier management
tasks.brief: Build the supplier screen: list of suppliers per shop, payment terms, lead time, contact. Done when the supplier is saved and appears in the purchase order screen.
tasks.done: When supplier management works and suppliers appear in purchase orders

tasks.title: Add purchase order and stock update
tasks.brief: Build the purchase order screen: create per shop, receive from supplier, update flower stock. Done when the order saves and stock increments correctly and FEFO badge updates.
tasks.done: When purchase order works end-to-end with stock update and FEFO badge

tasks.title: Add cash register per shop with FEFO discount
tasks.brief: Build the cash register per shop: scan bundle SKU or product, apply FEFO discount if urgent, tender payment, print receipt with bundle details and vase-life notes. Done when the sale records correctly and receipt prints with bundle name and vase-life notes.
tasks.done: When cash register per shop works end-to-end with FEFO discount and receipt prints

tasks.title: Add bundle sales per period report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing bundles created, sold, expired per month and revenue per bundle per period. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When bundle sales report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add FEFO vase-life aggregate report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing total stems fading per period by days (3/5/7), value at risk, discounts applied. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When FEFO vase-life aggregate report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add order pipeline report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing orders by status per period and average delivery time per period. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When order pipeline report computes correctly from live data

risks: Encryption key loss makes bundle and order records unrecoverable
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
FEFO vase-life without proper batch tracking can lead to selling faded flowers to customers
Delivery slot without clear confirmation can lead to no-show disputes and wasted bundles
